services.name: Jordan Lake Supyak Rental
services.desc: Glide or paddle across Jordan Lake on a one-of-a-kind SupYak adventure that combines the comfort and stability of a kayak with the fun of SUP! Ages 18+ to rent • Ages 5+ to ride • 1.5 & 4 hr options

services.name: Jordan Lake Stand Up Paddleboard Rental
services.desc: Beat the summer heat while having a fun day on Jordan Lake with our Stand Up Paddleboards! Weekdays (Tuesday - Thursday): $40 Weekends (Thursday - Sunday): $50 Holidays (Labor Day Weekend): $60 Closed Mondays to the public. (Mondays are available for large groups/corporate events - call to book). Durations 1.5 Hours About Ages 5-17 need parental Adult & Junior Paddleboards • 18+ to rent • Ages 5+ to ride • 1.5 & 4 hr options

services.name: Jet Ski Excursion
services.desc: Is riding a Jet ski on your bucket list? JetSki excursions are the perfect way to explore Jordan lake and experience the thrill and excitement of riding a Jet ski, without the responsibility. Our experienced staff will operate the jet ski while you enjoy taking in the sights and sensations. The operator will only operate the jet ski at a safe speed in which you feel most comfortable. Jet ski excursions feature brand new 2020, 3 seater, Sea-Doos with an integrated blue tooth enabled 100 watt sound system. Jetski excursions are for 1-2 people (450 lb max). No experience Starting at $50

services.name: Jordan Lake Tandem Kayak Rental
services.desc: Tandem Kayaks are a great option for families with young children, or anyone who doesn't want to kayak on their own. Tandem kayaks are more stable than canoes and great for family picnics and exploring. Weekdays (Tuesday - Thursday): $90 Weekends (Thursday - Sunday): $100 Holidays (Labor Day Weekend): $125 Closed Mondays to the public. Call to book large groups/corporate events Durations 1.5 Hours About Perception Tribe 13.5" Tandem Kayak Farrington Point is a popular area of Jordan known for kayaking, paddle boarding, & sandy 1.5 & 4 hr options • appropriate for all ages • can add a pet or small child

services.name: Jordan Lake Canoe Rentals
services.desc: A Family Favorite!! Check out the nesting areas of bald eagles, ospreys, and other bird species. Weekdays (Tuesday - Thursday): $100 Weekends (Friday - Sunday): $125 Holidays (Labor Day Weekend): $135 Durations 1.5 Hours About A leisurely cruise launching from the Lake Park boat ramp exploring the 2 mile perimeter of the lake can usually be done in a couple of hours or Explore nearby beaches, islands, & secluded coves and inlets on Jordan Lake!

services.name: Jordan Lake Single Kayak Rental
services.desc: Explore Jordan Lake’s scenic coves and shorelines by kayak - many wildlife viewing opportunities! Adult and Junior Kayaks - 1.5 hour & 4 hour options

services.name: Eco-Friendly Boat Rental for 2, Jordan Lake
services.desc: Relax, explore, or work on your tan while listening to your favorite music in an environmentally friendly, electric boat for 1-2 people! This, eco-friendly electric boat includes a retractable sun shade, 2 cup holders, AM/FM radio/Bluetooth audio sound system, optional fishing pole holder, as well as a storage bin that can be used to ice down beverages or store personal belongings Top speed of 4 mph, which means minimal impact to Jordan Lake's fish and wildlife Easy to operate, simply turn the knob to desired Forward or Reverse setting. Rental includes lifejackets for 2, boat safety and For the Environmentally Conscious, and those who enjoy boating at a slower pace. Max weight 450 lbs

services.name: LUXURY Sea Doo GTX 230 Limited Rental

Ultra-Comfort premium seats for up to 3 people weighing under 600 lbs, a generous 18.5 gallon fuel tank, unmatched stability and a wide stable boarding platform - the GTX Limited provides hours of platinum level luxury with 230 hp high octane attitude!
